item_short_desc: Rothco’s Tactical Pen is the ultimate everyday carry (EDC) tool, combining practicality and durability. Constructed from high-quality aluminum, this lightweight pen features an emergency glass breaker tip, making it a reliable tool for survival situations. Hidden within the pen is a discreet handcuff key, adding an extra layer of utility. Its refillable ink cartridge ensures long-lasting use, making it as functional for writing as it is for emergencies.
